_comment: Per-record dispositions for feedback arrivals, keyed (env|estate|channel|record id). ⛔ THIS FILE IS TRACKED IN A PUBLIC REPO. No note text and no personId ever land here — the words live in .private/ and person ids live in the private sibling's grants.json. A `why` is written by a human and goes public with it: say where the record went, never what anybody said. A batch may never be cleared by one of its members, so there is no bulk write and no watermark.

home|est-e6696a|feedback|onboard-address.why: Retained data log of a SUCCESSFUL onboarding, not debris. The 10:22 ET (14:22Z) run created est-e6696a:account:pkirsch + its grant under personId p-lnxakyzniuwk; Paul asked at ~11:05 ET for those two keys to be deleted so his beat-3 walk would start blank, explicitly keeping the feedback ('we keep the data log for analysis'). The orphaned personId is that deletion working as asked. Cited: cycle/release/CYCLE-LOG.md:797. Superseded by the 15:17Z run under p-yjnw9lt41nww.
